{{nihongo|'''Kumano Shrine (Kumanomichi, Fuchu Town)'''|熊野神社（婦中町熊野道）}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Etchū Province]].
